repos_data.description: MCP server that lets AI agents query SQL databases in natural language - read-only, with column masking, row caps, and query limits. SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL.
Secure MCP server for safe, read-only DB access by AI agents, with SQL guardrails, table allowlists, PII masking, and audit logs
MCP server for SQLite — query databases, inspect schemas, explain queries
A general-purpose MCP server that lets AI work with multiple databases within clear boundaries.
MCP server for secure database access (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite)
MySQL Server implementation for Model Context Protocol (MCP) written in Go.

An MCP server that provides safe, read-only access to SQLite databases through Model Context Protocol (MCP). This server is built with the FastMCP framework, which enables LLMs to explore and query SQLite databases with built-in safety features and query validation.
A Model Context Protocol server that provides read-only access to MySQL databases. This server enables LLMs to inspect database schemas and execute read-only queries.
A powerful multi-database server implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide AI assistants with structured access to databases.

An MCP server (and a CLI) that lets an LLM query your databases in natural language through a business semantic layer — glossary, metric definitions, data dictionary, knowledge base, and example queries — grounded against your real schema.
Secure read-only MCP server for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server — built for ThinAir Data, operational analytics, reporting, and AI-assisted database workflows.

repo_meta_data.description: Read-only MCP server for querying PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite from AI agents — multi-database, safe by default.
